official_docs.verified_constraint: Defold HTML5 persistence is browser-backed and may lag the immediate file operation, so rapid lifecycle proof must respect pending durability semantics.
Defold HTML5 saves use the virtual filesystem backed by IndexedDB and corrupt load behavior requires protected recovery handling.
Defold HTML5 uses an asynchronous FS.syncfs persistence path initiated by its loader after file close; the merged BB-007 lifecycle correction aligns rapid-window expectations with that behavior.
